findings.finding: The mutable event file is revalidated before a path replacement, but the final validation-to-replace gap can still overwrite a non-cooperating event update and the initial raw event bytes are not carried through generic writes.
findings.action: Carry the initial raw event bytes through the commit and replace overwrite semantics with a no-overwrite atomic event ledger; add deterministic competition at the actual commit boundary and migrate every reader and recovery path.
